source: Motta et al. 2025, Ameghiniana 62, Fig. 5 (1), 'Consensus EW': reduced consensus with Imperobator antarcticus (green box); rectangular, root left, thick lines coloured by group, clade abbreviations beside nodes. Trees 2-4 (other weightings and pruned consensuses) are excluded. Image: census figure (2571x3478 px), the embedded raster.
region_note: tree 1 (Consensus EW, top left); trees 2-4 are other analyses of the same taxa
license: unverified: no licence statement in the text held
names_note: no matrix held; list = the printed tip names of tree 1, including the higher-taxon tips (Scansoriopterygidae, Oviraptorosauria, Troodontidae, Microraptora, Eudromaeosauridae, Anchiornithidae, Enantiornithes, Euornithes), the eight Archaeopteryx specimens and 'Neuquenraptor - Unenlagia' as one tip
gold_note: Paravian reduced consensus, tree 1. The Eumaniraptora node is one continuous vertical (checked at 1.7x; the blue upper part and the black lower part share it), so it is a 14-way polytomy; the unenlagiid node is 7-way. The node abbreviations PA, EUM, DR and UNEN are printed on the tree and expanded in the caption (Paraves, Eumaniraptora, Dromaeosauridae, Unenlagiidae); they are kept as printed internal labels, unlike numeral or letter keys. 29 tips, 2 polytomies (14, 7 children); 4 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Random-sample case (seed 20261122). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
